author: WessTheMess
body:
About 30 minutes ago, I was playing a match on Throwback DTM and I ran into a hacker. I checked what staff were online, and I saw that myworld6 was online. So I /report-ed the player a couple of times, I kept checking if myworld6 was joining the lobby or not. Then I messaged them, asking if they could do something but I got no response. I kept reporting the players for the next 20-30 minutes and kept checking if they would finally join our lobby, which they didn't. So either myworld6 was ignoring the reports and messages, or was being afk. I feel like staying afk as a staffmember shouldn't be allowed, since people will think they can report other players. This will eventually make people annoyed at the staffmembers, and that is something you don't want.
If myworld6 had a good reason to stay afk, I will apologize. But I hope that something will happen to prevent this in the future.

Thanks,
wesseltjuuuh

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Just to let you know, staff can be AFK and it's something that has, does, and will happen; just like a player can be AFK. I understand you may think he is coming when he's not, but if you message him and he isn't taking reports actively you can assume he's not actually moderating at that very time.

Note they may also very well can be scrimming, playing with friends, and while we do tell them they can't always ignore reports, it is ok that they relax and turn reports off for a few matches.
